posts.content_md:
Ed did a great job on the cross reference of film vs chemistry vs hologram type in this Wiki section on most of the films. I find this section to be one of most importance for anyone whom wants to play with a new film to make a particular type of hologram. But it is not complete. With the growth of more holographers using green lasers I think it would be very advantageous to have this section as complete as possible.

[http://www.holographyforum.org/HoloWiki ... ogram_Type](http://www.holographyforum.org/HoloWiki/index.php/Silver_Halide_Film_vs_Chemistry_vs_Hologram_Type)

Does anyone have experience with VRP-M? For Ref and Trans? Which chemistries work best? What the final hologram should yield with a particular chemistry? (I think Ed's format it great)

If you don't have change access to the Wiki or don't want it, post the info here and I will put it in.

Thanks in advance,

John
